title: Value of a literal vertex
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $x$ assign Boolean values to the $n$ inputs, let $i$ be an input index, and let $b$ be a Boolean value. In the circuit consisting of one negation gate for each input, the value at the vertex representing the literal that is true exactly when $x(i)=b$ is the truth value of $x(i)=b$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ inputs
